narration: Billions of copies last for thousands of years with no power, so DNA's the ultimate backup drive for humanity.
description: Vertical 1080x1920 dark background. Center-middle single glowing accent=cyan DNA helix vertical. It duplicates into hundreds of small glowing cyan and magenta helices swirling and funneling into a small glass vial centered in middle band. Vial glows good=green. Frozen ice-blue overlay with large fg=white year counter '0 YEARS -> 10,000 YEARS' beside vial and bold white text 'ULTIMATE BACKUP'. No key elements in top 10% or bottom 25%.

beats.action: Single bright cyan helix rotates large in center
Helix duplicates into dozens then hundreds of glowing helices filling center cloud
Camera pulls back, cloud funnels down into small glass vial center, year counter starts ticking fast
Grey power plug icon appears and fades with red X, vial glows green and freezes with ice shine
Bold white 'ULTIMATE BACKUP DRIVE' text scales up behind vial, vial pulses
